title: Authority with room to breathe
question: This hand keeps confident positioning and proof, but reduces density: fewer sections, larger moments, and quieter evidence. Every direction has equal light and dark themes.

options.label: The Clear Frame
options.lineage: speaker portraits · technical essays · quiet studio portfolios
options.thesis: One clear portrait, one strong idea, and a small set of well-chosen proof make Nick’s authority feel immediate rather than exhaustive.
options.viewport: Nick’s portrait and AI-native DX thesis own the first screen; a concise role line and Workshops action sit nearby, with only three proof paths beginning below: Build, Teach, Write.
options.risk: Restraint can become bland if the portrait scale, type character, and purple/teal field are timid; the page needs one memorable transition, not many widgets.
options.case: Closest to your steer: Zack-level confidence, much less catalog density, and enough space for Nick’s personality to lead.

options.label: Type in Motion
options.lineage: variable-type specimens · modern editorial covers · responsive practice
options.thesis: A single expressive headline subtly changes weight as the visitor moves from Nick’s thesis to the work that proves it.
options.case: Spacious and technically distinctive without being busy; stronger personal signature than the category standard, but typography must not become the subject.
options.viewport: A huge AI-native DX headline, calm portrait, and one Workshops action fill the screen; the next fold contains three large evidence statements rather than a grid of cards.
options.risk: Can read like a type-foundry demo; motion must stay subtle, reduced-motion must be complete, and body reading must remain conventional.

options.label: The Depth Planes
options.lineage: multiplane composition · photographic depth · calm narrative reveals
options.thesis: Nick’s practice gains depth through three slowly separated planes: current work, public teaching, and the archive behind both.
options.case: Most visual while remaining sparse; useful if the site should feel more experiential than editorial, with genuine photography carrying the depth.
options.viewport: A large portrait plane, thesis plane, and restrained evidence plane overlap without cards; scrolling separates them and lands naturally on Workshops.
options.risk: Parallax can feel decorative or impair reading; the still fallback must remain a complete composition and dark mode cannot become cinematic black-on-black.

options.label: The Single Event
options.lineage: particle event displays · one source with a few meaningful paths
options.thesis: One central idea radiates into only the evidence that matters: systems, workshops, writing, and speaking.
options.case: Distinctive technical metaphor with lots of negative space; it works only if the paths stay few and are built as precise SVG, not decorative particles.
options.viewport: Nick and the AI-native DX thesis sit at the event’s center; four quiet paths lead to the work, with Workshops carrying the active purple/teal signal.
options.risk: The scientific metaphor can overshadow Nick or become generic particle decoration; no WebGL spectacle and no unverified metrics.

canonCard.label: Spacious personal-site canon
canonCard.thesis: A refined portrait hero, concise authority statement, workshops action, and three generous proof sections.
canonCard.viewport: Portrait and thesis side by side, one primary action, selected writing and talks spaced generously below.
canonCard.risk: Clear and durable but less memorable; choose it if the authored concepts still feel like too much.
